text.p: Vari-L Co Inc said Wednesday it signed a letter of intent to form a Chinese manufacturing venture with state run Chen-Hui Co.

The pact, which is subject to reaching a definitive agreement, calls for Vari-L to contribute a license of its proprietary processes along with its manufacturing, marketing and business expertise to the venture in return for a 51 percent ownership position. Chen-Hui, which will own the remaining 49 percent, will contribute plant, equipment and labor, and will obtain all necessary government approvals, including assurances of patent and trade secret protection.

Chen-Hui will manufacture Vari-L's products at a state-owned factory in Beijing, for distribution to Chinese and worldwide markets. Products covered under the joint agreement will include Vari-L's patented Voltage Controlled Oscillators and Phase Locked Loop Synthesizers.
